pageScope: Runs cleanups, registry fixes and updates at set times, when the conditions you choose are met. With auto-apply, actions start without confirmation.
pageDescription: Automate scans, cleanups, and updates on a schedule
emptyStateDescription: The schedules you create appear here, with their next run and the result of the last one.
upcomingNote: Scheduled times: run conditions can postpone a run.
maxSchedulesReached: You have reached the maximum of {{max}} schedules.
failedEnableStartup: Could not enable start at sign-in: schedules may not run after a restart.
deleteConfirmDescription: The schedule is deleted and will no longer run. This cannot be undone: to get it back, create it again.

presets.weeklyFullCleanDescription: All cleanup categories every Monday at 9:00, without confirmation
presets.dailyLightSweepDescription: System, browsers and Recycle Bin every day at 8:00, without confirmation
presets.monthlyDeepMaintenanceDescription: Full cleanup, registry, drivers and software on the 1st at 10:00, without confirmation
presets.customDescription: An empty schedule to fill in

dialog.autoApplyDescription: Cleans files, fixes the registry and installs updates without asking for confirmation.
dialog.autoApplyWarning: Actions start on their own at the scheduled time. Check the exclusions list first.

advanced.title: Run conditions
advanced.explanation: All conditions are checked before a run starts. Between tasks, power, idle time and Game Mode are checked again; the maintenance window and free-space threshold only gate the start, so a workflow that begins inside the window or below the threshold finishes its remaining tasks. Times follow this computer's local time zone. Running operations finish before a changed condition stops the remaining tasks.
advanced.gameMode: Wait while Game Mode is active or restoring
advanced.disk: Only when the home drive is low on space
advanced.missed: If the scheduled time is missed or conditions are not ready
advanced.skip: Skip after the two-minute start window
advanced.once: Run once when ready; combine missed runs
advanced.runConfirm: The saved tasks run, with the schedule's auto-apply choice. The power, idle, Game Mode, space and maintenance-window conditions still apply: if they hold the run back, it starts at a later check; choosing Run now again while it waits cancels it.
advanced.workflowHint: Tasks run from top to bottom. A category restriction applies only to future matching scan results. Recycle Bin remains a whole-bin operation.
advanced.scopeHint: Only checked categories will be included. An empty selection runs no cleanup in this task. Scan discovers categories currently present; it does not clean.
advanced.waitForScan: Wait for the current scan or cleanup to finish.
advanced.noCategories: No categories found. Run a new scan when the app has cached data.

waiting.game-mode: Waiting for Game Mode to finish
waiting.changed: Schedule was edited; queued definition discarded
waiting.interrupted: The run lost its window and was recorded as failed; this occurrence will not replay.

advanced.saveFailed: The schedule could not be saved. Try again.
